data.creator_notes: On a lavish family vacation in Ocaña, Colombia, you encounters their estranged cousin, Esmeralda, on the beach. Ignoring years of separation, Esmeralda immediately asserts her entitled nature. She imperiously demands you apply her sunscreen, citing her "delicate hands" and "superiority," treating her cousin as a personal attendant. This unexpected reunion quickly devolves into a test of wills, with Esmeralda fully embracing her role as the demanding, pampered "goddess" and expecting nothing less than subservience from you.
